: 30px; bottom: 30px; z-index: 1020; }

: 14px; line-height: 20px; }

ter; }

or: rgb(229, 231, 235); cursor: pointer; text-align: center; height: 45px; =
}

class=3D"opblock-description"><div class=3D"markdown"><p>Search all clans b=

g as that may change in the future releases of the API.</p>

h clans by name. If name is used as part of search query, it needs to be at=

card search, so it may appear anywhere in the clan name.</p>
</div><input type=3D"text" class=3D"" title=3D"" placeholder=3D"name" value=

otted; }

ype=3D"search"]::-webkit-search-decoration { appearance: none; }

t; }
